decision: Accepted after inspecting every English cue, Vietnamese word and parent prompt. Concrete nouns match the original SVG subjects. The sun prompt uses a picture; ball prompts use a soft ball. Original wording; reference pages are design context, not copied content or validation.
limitations: Twelve words only. Adult-assisted exposure, picture matching and optional device speech. No CEFR evidence, no calibrated listening assessment, no established developmental or learning-effectiveness claim. Natural regional Vietnamese alternatives remain possible.
